props.name: rowLabels
props.description: One per row; empty strings skip a row, e.g. ["", "Mon", "", "Wed"].

props.name: columnLabels
props.description: One per column; empty strings skip a column. Long labels overflow right.

props.name: levels
props.description: Steps on the ramp, counting the empty level 0.

props.name: max
props.description: Value of the fullest step. Defaults to the largest value.

props.name: formatCell
props.description: Readout text and tooltip for a cell.

props.name: caption
props.description: Shown in the footer when no cell is active.

props.name: scrollTo
props.description: Where a wide map starts scrolled: the first or last column.

components.name: HeatmapLegend
components.description: "Less ▢▢▢▢▢ More": the ramp as a key.

examples.title: visits by weekday and hour · hover or pick a cell
examples.code:
<Heatmap
  values={VISITS}
  rowLabels={DAYS}
  columnLabels={HOURS.map((hour) =>
    hour % 3 === 0 ? hourLabel(hour) : ""
  )}
  size="lg"
  color="oklch(0.62 0.19 260)"
  selectable
  formatCell={(cell) =>
    `${cell.value} visits · ${DAYS[cell.row]} ${hourLabel(cell.column)}`
  }
  caption="Last 30 days"
  aria-label="Visits by weekday and hour"
/>

examples.title: round · 3 levels · no labels
examples.code:
<Heatmap
  values={VISITS.slice(0, 3).map((row) => row.slice(8, 20))}
  shape="round"
  size="xl"
  levels={3}
  color="oklch(0.7 0.16 45)"
/>
